left.raw_text: 1. Written informed consent must be obtained before any assessment is performed.

right.raw_text: 2. Male and female patients age 18 to 85 years of age inclusive at screening

left.raw_text: 3. Presence of type I or type II diabetes mellitus

right.raw_text: 4. The ETDRS letter score in the study eye must be between 24 and 70 letters (approximate Snellen equivalent of 20/40-20/320).

left.raw_text: 5. Presence of DME in the study eye, with decrease in vision due to foveal thickening of central macular thickness ≥ 320 µm in the central subfield, as assessed on SD-OCT and confirmed by the central reading center at screening
